happening.text: The visitors arrive on the square at the top of Saltstair, between the chapel and the inn.

happening.subject: anchor/quay
happening.text: The visitors reach the quay at the foot of the street, the town stepped up the hill behind them.

objectives.hint: Down every flight of the main street, to the stone quay where it meets the sea.
objectives.title: Go down to the quay

happening.subject: anchor/quay
happening.text: The walk down Saltstair is done on the quay.
